newsitem.title: USA: Paracelsus says Conroy resigns from board.
newsitem.headline: Paracelsus says Conroy resigns from board.

text.p: Paracelsus Healthcare Corp said that James Conroy had resigned as director.

The company said he was a member of the special committee initially consisting of three non-management directors appointed by the board late last year to investigate the company's earnings shortfall in the third quarter of 1996.

In his resignation letter, Conroy cited his disagreement with what he described as the special committee's unwillingness to address the issue of the responsibility of the pre-merger Paracelsus directors for the reporting and accounting irregularities and errors found by the special committee, the company said in a news release.

Conroy also cited his disagreement with the decision of other members of the company's current board not to disclose more about the results of the special committee's inquiry to the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company said it believes the findings were properly disclosed.
